in_sanskrit.name: Sahnawaz
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Protector

It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sahna', which means to protect or defend. This name is often given to children who are expected to grow up to be strong and brave individuals, capable of safeguarding themselves and their loved ones.
